tips.caption: Don't carry all your cash around
tips.narration: Die or get busted and every dollar on you is gone. Stash it under the loose floorboards in Jason's bedroom. Trust me, I learned the hard way.
tips.footage: Jason dies holding cash, counter drops to $0, then stashing money under floorboards

tips.caption: Don't kick in doors that glow red
tips.narration: Click both sticks for Focus Mode before a robbery. Red doors are wired to the alarm. Go around, or lockpick them once you've got the tool.
tips.footage: Focus Mode showing a red door, alarm triggering when kicked, then quiet entry

tips.caption: Don't commit crimes in your normal outfit
tips.narration: Cops remember your clothes, and that heat is hard to shake. Hat and bandana for the job, spare outfit in the trunk, then stroll right past them.
tips.footage: Robbing a store in hat and bandana, changing from car trunk, walking past police

tips.caption: Don't steal cars with advanced trackers early
tips.narration: Those trackers bring cops straight to you. Leave those cars alone until later, when you can pay a lot to get the trackers pulled.
tips.footage: Stealing a tracked car and getting chased immediately

tips.caption: Don't make a supercar your main ride
tips.narration: Supercars fold like paper. Grab a street bike, drop about fifteen grand on the racing upgrade, and weave through traffic while the cops eat dust.
tips.footage: Supercar crumpling after a crash, then street bike weaving through traffic escaping police

tips.caption: Don't expect GTA 5-style auto-aim
tips.narration: Aiming's manual now. Practice at Rodgers Ranch near Port Gellhorn to build Focus for longer slow-mo. Head or heart kills; limbs just injure.
tips.footage: Missed shots without aim assist, then a slow-motion headshot at the shooting range

tips.caption: Don't pay for a tow when your car flips
tips.narration: Keep walking into the car until the shove prompt shows up, then hold Square. Back on its wheels, free. Works on stuck boats too.
tips.footage: Car on its roof, shove prompt appears, car lands back on its wheels
